title.zh: Perplexity改进AI自蒸馏：不光训练学生，也要训练老师
title.en: Perplexity改进AI自蒸馏：不光训练学生，也要训练老师

current_state.zh: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduce JOLT, a self-distillation method that trains the teacher role with outcome rewards and KL constraints, outperforming prior self-distillation and GRPO on MATH while showing weaker results on an agent benchmark unless student rewards are added.
current_state.en: Perplexity and NVIDIA introduce JOLT, a self-distillation method that trains the teacher role with outcome rewards and KL constraints, outperforming prior self-distillation and GRPO on MATH while showing weaker results on an agent benchmark unless student rewards are added.
